About

Lahore mein ek chhota sa Greece

Kafenio Gulberg II ki Hali Road par waqeh ek Greek cafe hai — jahan din ki shuruaat ek thande Freddo se hoti hai aur sham souvlaki aur baklava par khatam. Greek cafe culture mein “kafenio” mohalle ki woh jagah hoti hai jahan log waqt guzarne, doston se milne aur sakoon se coffee peene aate hain — yehi rooh is cafe mein bhi hai.

Google par 4.6 stars (147 reviews) ke sath Kafenio apne Greek khano aur coffee ki wajah se jana jata hai. Cafe Foodpanda par bhi active hai, aur Instagram par @kafeniopk (~6.4K followers) par is ki updates milti hain.

Kafenio ki abhi koi official website nahi hai — ye page sirf ek demo hai jo Rana AI OS ne is business ki public maloomat se banaya hai.

Menu Specialities

Kafenio ki pehchan

Ye chaar cheezein Kafenio ko Lahore ke baqi cafes se alag karti hain. Kisi bhi item par WhatsApp se maloomat lein.

Signature Drink

Freddo Coffee

Greece ki sab se mashhoor thandi coffee — double espresso ko baraf ke sath shake karke layered foam ke sath serve ki jati hai. Lahore ki garmi mein Kafenio ki sab se zyada mangi jane wali drink.

WhatsApp par poochhen
Greek Grill

Souvlaki

Marinated gosht ke grilled skewers — garam pita, tzatziki, salad aur lemon ke sath. Greece ka street-food classic, Kafenio ki grill se seedha aap ki plate tak.

WhatsApp par poochhen
Fresh Bakery

Croissants

Halki, buttery aur flaky layers wale fresh-baked croissants — subah ki coffee ke sath behtareen jodi. Nashtay aur halki bhook dono ke liye pasandeeda.

WhatsApp par poochhen
Sweet Finish

Baklava

Patli filo layers, crushed nuts aur sheera — upar se pista ki sajawat. Khane ka woh meetha ikhtetam jis ke baghair Greek dawat adhoori hai.
